# A Warm San Francisco Night

*Giọng jazz nhẹ nhàng, ấm áp*

🎵

**Verse 1:**
Fog is rolling in so slow
Golden Gate begins to glow
City lights like stars below
On this warm San Francisco night

**Verse 2:**
Cable cars have gone to sleep
Painted ladies secrets keep
Through the avenues we creep
On this warm San Francisco night

**Chorus:**
Feel the breeze from the bay
Wash our worries away
In your arms I wanna stay
Under these city lights so bright
On a warm San Francisco night

**Bridge:**
From the wharf to Nob Hill's height
Everything just feels so right
Hold me closer, hold me tight
On this warm San Francisco night

*Kết thúc với giai điệu saxophone mơ màng*

🎷✨🌉

---

*Bài hát mang hơi hướng jazz/soul, tưởng tượng Tony Bennett hay Norah Jones hát, với background là khung cảnh San Francisco về đêm - lãng mạn, ấm áp và đầy cảm xúc.*
